item.title: Gabriel 'Fluffy' Iglesias honored with star on Hollywood Walk of Fame
item.description: CONGRATS! Gabriel "Fluffy" Iglesias has his very own star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame. He's been doing stand-up since 1997 and was the first comedian to sell out Dodger Stadium for a show.

item.title: Couples sue OC fertility doctor, claiming embryos were 'kidnapped' and moved without their consent
item.description: More than two dozen couples using an Orange County fertility clinic have filed a lawsuit, claiming its former medical director, whose license has since been suspended, moved their embryos to another facility without their knowledge.

item.title: LA city officials, advocates oppose proposed HUD rule to limit public housing to citizens
item.description: The rule would require every resident in HUD-funded housing to show proof of citizenship or eligible status.

item.title: Driver arrested, booked for vehicular manslaughter, DUI in crash that killed toddler in Long Beach
item.description: The mother of the 20-month-old little girl saw the deadly crash happen right in front of her. Police believe the driver responsible was under the influence.

item.title: Westlake man dies while in ICE custody at Adelanto detention center, LA councilmember says
item.description: Alberto Gutierrez Reyes lived in L.A.'s Westlake District, according to his family. He's being remembered as a beloved neighbor, father and devoted husband.

item.title: Strong, gusty winds move into SoCal this week
item.description: Strong, gusty winds are moving into Southern California this week before another warmup arrives over the weekend.

item.title: California bill to bar police from taking second job with ICE advances in state Assembly
item.description: A bill that would prevent police officers from moonlighting with federal immigration enforcement agencies is advancing through the California State Assembly.

item.title: Democrats in CA governor race asked to drop out if they aren't viable, but no one wants to
item.description: California's governor's race is very crowded, and now, the chair of the California Democratic Party is urging struggling candidates to drop out to avoid splitting votes.

item.title: Video shows driver narrowly avoid disaster as loose boat darts across 91 Freeway
item.description: "I had seconds to respond": Shocking dashcam video shows the moment the boat became unhitched and quickly drifted across several lanes of traffic before jumping the median.

item.title: Irvine teen breaks silence after at-home science lab sparks FBI hazmat investigation
item.description: A 17-year-old just months away from earning his degree from UC Irvine is speaking out after his at-home science lab led to a weeklong investigation. He believes it's all a big misunderstanding.
